scientific_integrity: The classification is established by explicit block derivation identities, eigenspace splitting, and complementary-subspace counting. Finite-field exhaustive computations corroborate selected instances only; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Free class-two nilpotent Lie algebras with at least three generators; ordinary idempotent derivations; exact labeled finite-field rank distribution and reduced component geometry only. Does not treat the nonreduced scheme, conjugacy orbits, or higher nilpotence class. The d=2 Heisenberg case is prior work. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: Modular rank spectra and nonabelian images of idempotent derivations of free class-two Lie algebras
